entryPointDiscriminators.assignmentRule: Root cause in script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol, package.json, or the JS chain => 'promotion-ready:broadcast' (matches run-22 so its 12 open findings reconcile). Root cause SOLELY in script/VerifyPromotionReady.s.sol => 'promotion-ready:verify'.

chainIdSource: require(block.chainid == CHAIN_ID) in both setUp() (DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:375) and run() (:387); CHAIN_ID = 1 constant at :356
intentComment: Story 072 - THE PROMOTION-READY CUTOVER. One differential mainnet broadcast promoting the accumulated nft-staking (9611312) / yield-claim-nft (9c18020) / stable-yield-accumulator (6eab35c) work. Five coupled changes: (1) deploy NudgeStreamer and convert every donor from 'push USDC at the batch-minter' to 'approve + collectNudge through the streamer'; (2) redeploy all four donor dispatchers - BalancerPoolerV2 (idx 4), Uniboost x3 (idx 1/2/3), NudgeRatchet (idx 7) - plus StableYieldAccumulator; (3) replace the shared BatchNFTMinter with BatchNFTMinterMultiToken, whitelist USDC/phUSD/Kendu and registerStream at 10/30/30 days; (4) silently migrate the three NFTStakerDepletion instances to NFTStakerDepletionV2 via NFTStakerMigrator; (5) retire the old batch minter (setPauser(OWNER) + pause()). THE FIVE MINT-DEBT HOOKS ARE REPOINTED, NOT REDEPLOYED, so there are ZERO phUSD.setMinter calls. Per index the order is pull() -> hook.setDispatcher(new) -> new.setHook(hook) -> replaceDispatcher(idx, new): fail-closed.

docKeys.//promotion-ready: present (package.json) - the master intent block quoted above
docKeys.//promotion-ready:dry: present - declares the dry run the verification gate for story 072; enumerates Phase 8's blocking probes (Kendu FoT, MintPageView, donor paths with POSITIVE BatchDonatedViaPSM check, 40-mint batchMint after vm.warp, ArrayLengthMismatch negative test outside any broadcast block, BPT recovery)
docKeys.//promotion-ready:broadcast: present - documents --legacy + 0.5 gwei flat price (story-071 lesson), --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 (story-073 lesson), the MANDATORY patch tail, and that the chain then ends with '&& npm run promotion-ready:verify' (story 075 / run-22 M-01)
docKeys.//promotion-ready:resume: present - progress file 'LIES' on write-side entries; TRIM THE 'contracts' BLOCK ONLY, NEVER the top-level 'baselines' block; BPT move aborts if old pooler balance is already 0
docKeys.//promotion-ready:verify: present - read-only post-broadcast verification; consumes baselines.bptAtCutover and NEVER re-derives it; explicitly says story-072 checklist line 1197 is NOT discharged here and remains a human step
docKeys.//order-of-execution:human-readable: present - 'promotion-ready:snapshot then promotion-ready:dry then promotion-ready:broadcast. After success, mint an LSP NFT and check that it truly pools on balancer. If the cutover fails, consult Claude on how to resume.'
docKeys.note: No '//promotion-ready:snapshot' doc key exists; the snapshot prerequisite is documented only inside //promotion-ready and //order-of-execution:human-readable.

snapshot.role: hard prerequisite - produces the Phase 6 migrate() user list
snapshot.coupling: Phase 6 (_loadSnapshotUsers, :1599-1601) reads scripts/snapshots/depletion-stakers-latest.json via vm.readFile. Not enforced by any require in the npm chain - purely procedural. If the file is absent, vm.readFile reverts inside Phase 6, i.e. AFTER Phases 1-5 have already been queued for broadcast.

dry.behaviour: isPreview=true => vm.startPrank(OWNER) instead of vm.startBroadcast(); NO progress file written; Phase 8 preview smoke tests RUN (only path on which the blocking Kendu fee-on-transfer probe executes).
dry.note: Runs against LIVE mainnet over --rpc-url (not --fork-url); forge's local EVM applies the prank against fetched state.

broadcast.command: node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && forge script script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:DeployMainnetPromotionReady --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price 0.5gwei --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-promotion-ready.js && npm run promotion-ready:verify
broadcast.chainSeparator: && throughout (never ;) - each leg gated on a zero exit from the prior
broadcast.behaviour: isPreview=false => vm.startBroadcast(); progress file WRITTEN with status 'completed' after Phase 7; Phase 8 SKIPPED entirely (so the blocking Kendu FoT probe never runs on this path).

resume.command: forge script script/DeployMainnetPromotionReady.s.sol:DeployMainnetPromotionReady --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price 0.5gwei --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-promotion-ready.js && npm run promotion-ready:verify
resume.diffFromBroadcast: OMITS the leading backup-mainnet-addresses.js (already taken by the crashed :broadcast run). Same forge invocation, same mandatory patch tail, same verify tail.
resume.manualPrerequisite: Hand-trim server/deployments/progress.promotion-ready.1.json 'contracts' block to on-chain-confirmed steps, set deploymentStatus back to 'in_progress', NEVER touch the top-level 'baselines' block, then re-run :dry.

verify.behaviour: Read-only. No --broadcast, no --ledger, no --slow. Rejects PREVIEW_MODE=true via _requireNoBroadcastFlag(). Every check is a require, so failure exits non-zero and halts the && chain.
verify.standaloneUse: Safe to re-run at will independently of the cutover.

orderingCouplings.detail: Phase 6 (_loadSnapshotUsers) vm.readFile's scripts/snapshots/depletion-stakers-latest.json. Nothing in the npm chain, and no Phase 0 require, checks the file exists before the broadcast body begins.

The BLOCKING Kendu fee-on-transfer probe lives in Phase 8, which is `if (isPreview)` only. Under --broadcast Phase 2 whitelists Kendu UNCONDITIONALLY and Phase 8 never runs. Both the //promotion-ready:dry doc key and patch-mainnet-addresses-promotion-ready.js:52-58 state explicitly that this tax gate is PROCEDURAL, not structural.

orderingCouplings.direction: mandatory, must be the FINAL state-mutating element
orderingCouplings.detail: Doc key: 'THE TRAILING patch ... IS MANDATORY AND MUST BE THE FINAL STATE-MUTATING ELEMENT OF THE CHAIN - it is followed by the read-only npm run promotion-ready:verify leg (story 075) and by nothing else; never insert anything that writes between them.'

orderingCouplings.direction: new in story 075; chained onto BOTH :broadcast and :resume
orderingCouplings.detail: The verify leg is the sole outcome verification on the broadcast path (run-22 M-01). It is chained with && so it runs only after a successful patch.

_writeProgressFileWithStatus (:2205-2214) emits baselines.bptAtCutover (and story-075 siblings phusdMinterMask/phusdMintVersion) as decimal STRINGS. VerifyPromotionReady._adoptPersistedBptBaseline aborts if the baseline is absent or zero - deliberately no live-read fallback.

orderingCouplings.coupling: :verify depends on the progress file that :broadcast writes
orderingCouplings.detail: _loadAndValidateProgressFile requires progressFileExists AND all 14 runtime addresses non-zero AND _isDeployed('NudgeStreamer') && _isDeployed('BatchNFTMinter'). A verify run before any broadcast fails loudly (correct).
run() calls _phase5_stableYieldAccumulator() BEFORE _phase4d_retireOldBatchMinter(), out of numeric order, deliberately.

envAndKeys.RPC_MAINNET: required by every key except none; snapshot passes it explicitly, forge via --rpc-url
envAndKeys.ETHERSCAN_API_KEY: consumed only by foundry.toml [etherscan] mainnet; no --verify flag on any of the five keys, so contract verification is NOT part of this suite
envAndKeys.PREVIEW_MODE: read via vm.envOr in DeployMainnetPromotionReady.run() (:400) and rejected in VerifyPromotionReady._requireNoBroadcastFlag() (:97)
